LLM-RB.description: Wide-context intersection of Felzenszwalb segments on three PCs and a 2-pixel-lattice PC-gradient watershed; pixel vote of an RBF SVM on PCs, two smoothing scales and local PC std.

LLM-MRG.description: Baseline MRG regions with pixel-vote labelling: an RBF SVM classifies pixels from PCs and 2-pixel smoothed PCs, each MRG region takes the majority vote.

Baseline MRG.description: Modified region growing on the PCA V channel with histogram-frequency seeds, intensity and orientation constraints to the seed inside a 3x3 grid; regions described by 88 GLCM features and their mean spectrum.
